verdict.rationale: Paperspace's GPU cloud page explicitly says 'Bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access.' The machine docs cover SSH connections and choosing authentication when creating a machine. One hands-on report calls SSH setup 'an uphill battle' with a confusing console, but it describes friction rather than a failure, so it lowers quality rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on uploading and managing SSH keys, documentation of root access beyond marketing copy, and independent corroboration of a smooth SSH/root workflow.
